name: Amp
summary: Coding agent that runs tasks in isolated hosted or self-hosted environments called orbs.
description: Amp is a coding agent and development environment. Each agent runs in its own isolated environment, called an orb, so tasks continue after the user closes their laptop and can be followed from a phone. Threads can be shared with teammates. The Hobby plan is free with pay-as-you-go usage and unlimited self-hosted orbs; the Individual plan costs $20 per month, with higher team tiers above it.

howToUse.title: Open Amp
howToUse.description: Go to Amp and choose Start to use the coding agent and development environment.

howToUse.title: Run the task in an orb
howToUse.description: Put the task in an orb. That orb is the agent's own isolated environment, and tasks continue after the laptop closes. Follow the thread from a phone.

howToUse.title: Share the thread or use the CLI
howToUse.description: Share threads with teammates, or keep working on your own machine with the CLI and runner. Hobby includes pay-as-you-go usage and unlimited orbs that are self-hosted, with no subscription charge. Individual costs $20 per month, and team tiers sit above it.
